summary: Enhance your crisis communication skills with our expert-led course. Learn to manage public information and navigate emergencies with confidence and clarity.
lede: Crisis communication training prepares communication officers, spokespersons, and emergency coordinators to plan and deliver public information during high-pressure events. Participants practise drafting statements and Q&As, conducting press briefings, and coordinating internal and external messages while responding to misinformation across media and social channels. Simulations help teams assess response decisions and identify lessons to strengthen future plans.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who must navigate the complexities of crisis communication in high-stakes situations. It addresses the needs of those responsible for managing public information during critical times.
audience: Security, operations, and risk management teams
modules: Media and Press Relations in Crisis
Managing Public Information and Social Media
Ethical and Legal Considerations in Crisis Communication
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a basic understanding of communication principles and experience in handling public or media relations.
